login.subtitle: Sign in to the school dashboard
login.throttled: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
login.expired: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
login.refusedParent: Parents use the SchoolDimes mobile app, not this dashboard.
login.refusedStaff: This account can't use the web dashboard. Canteen and merchant staff use the POS app; parents use the mobile app.
login.whoFor: For school administrators, platform staff and students (student portal).

overview.title: Overview
overview.subtitle: Today, {date} (Africa/Kampala)
overview.staleHint: No sync within the school's stale limit
overview.booksHint: Every wallet in the school sums to zero
overview.simulatorNote: Until real POS devices are in use, sales, shortfalls and attendance come from the backend's simulate_pos command.

sales.title: Sales
sales.subtitle: From the ledger: every figure traces to POS transactions and their ledger entries.
sales.grossHint: Amount rung up at the till
sales.noItems: No line items were sent with this sale.

recon.title: Reconciliation
recon.subtitle: One Kampala day. POS figures are for transactions synced that day, when their ledger entries were written.
recon.traceNote: Every amount next to a ledger amount is recomputed from the ledger entries carrying its reference. Sum of every wallet in the school:
recon.clearingNote: The aggregator clearing wallet is normally negative: it is money the payment aggregator owes the school.

review.title: Review queue
review.subtitle: Offline sales that synced with a shortfall or broke a policy rule. Nothing is dropped: decide what happens here.
review.simulatorNote: Until real devices exist, this queue is filled by the backend's simulate_pos command.
review.resHelp_accept: No money moves. The flag is acknowledged and the sale stays as recorded.
review.resHelp_write_off: No money moves. The school (or merchant) absorbs the outstanding amount.
review.resHelp_recover_from_next_topup: Takes what the student's main wallet holds now, then collects from every later confirmed top-up until the shortfall is repaid.
review.resHelp_charge_guardian: Same as recovery, plus a payment request for the outstanding amount is sent to the primary guardian's phone.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.subtitle: Computed on request from POS line items and the ledger. Rejected sales are excluded.
analytics.nutritionNote: Nutrition flag: share of item revenue in categories this school marks as unhealthy (Products page). Sales sent without line items aren't in this breakdown.
analytics.pickStudentHint: Choose a student to see their spending in this period.

student.overrideBy: Student override last set by {who} ({role}) on {when}. Parents can only tighten school limits.
student.unlinkHelp: {parent} will no longer see or manage {student}'s wallet, card or history. Their account is not deleted.
student.linkHelp: The parent registers in the SchoolDimes app first. Enter the exact email of their account.
student.linkConfirm: {parent} will be able to see {student}'s balances and history, top up, set spending limits and freeze the card.
student.noActiveCard: This student has no usable card.
student.ledgerHelp: The append-only ledger. Balances are the sum of these entries; nothing is ever edited or deleted.
student.portalHelp: Optional read-only portal where the student sees their balance, savings goals and recent purchases. The physical card stays the main way students pay.
student.portalPasswordHelp: At least 8 characters. Give it to the student privately.
student.portalCreateHelp: Creates a read-only student login for {name}. It can never see other students.
student.portalRemoveHelp: The student will no longer be able to sign in to the portal. Their wallet and card are unaffected.

cards.title: Cards
cards.subtitle: Issue, freeze, replace and reset PINs. Changes reach POS devices on their next cache refresh.
cards.uidFormat: Card UID format: the NFC tag's bytes as lowercase hex with no separators, e.g. 04:A2:2B:7C:91:3E:80 is stored as 04a22b7c913e80. Read it with the POS app's dev "show UID" helper, or any NFC reader app.
cards.uidHelp: Tap the card on a reader and type its UID. Leave blank to let the server generate one (no physical card).
cards.uidInvalid: Must be 4–32 bytes of hex, e.g. 04:A2:2B:7C
cards.uidBlank: No UID: the server generates one (for testing without a physical card).
cards.pinHelp: 4 to 6 digits. It is hashed at once and never shown again.
cards.reissueWarning: The old card ({uid}) stays retired as lost. The new card gets a new UID and PIN.
cards.freezeHelp: Every purchase, transfer and fee payment from {name}'s card is refused at once. Offline POS devices refuse it after their next cache refresh. Guardians are notified.
cards.unfreezeHelp: {name}'s card can be used again. Guardians are notified.
cards.resetPinHelp: The old PIN stops working. POS devices pick up the new PIN on their next refresh. A card frozen after wrong PINs stays frozen until you unfreeze it.
cards.markLostHelp: Permanent: {name}'s card can never be used again. Issue a replacement afterwards.

guardians.title: Guardians & KYC
guardians.subtitle: Identity checks (KYC-lite) for parents linked to your students, and all guardian links.
guardians.reviewHelp: Check the parent's {doc} number {number} against the document they show you.
guardians.linkHint: To link or unlink a guardian, open the student.

devices.title: Devices
devices.subtitle: POS tills, merchant tills and attendance readers. A device that hasn't synced for {hours} h is marked stale.
devices.name: Device name
devices.roleHelp_canteen: Sells canteen products; can also take attendance taps if enabled in Policy & settings.
devices.roleHelp_merchant: Belongs to an approved nearby merchant; sells only that merchant's products.
devices.roleHelp_attendance: Gate reader: records tap-in/out, never moves money.
devices.rotateHelp: {name}'s current token stops working at once. You'll see the new token once; enter it on the device to keep it working. Unsynced sales on the device stay queued.
devices.revokeHelp: {name} is refused on its next request and can't be re-enabled (register a new device instead). Do this immediately for a lost or stolen till.
devices.onceHelp: This token is not stored anywhere readable. Copy it or scan the QR code with the POS app now. If it's lost, rotate the token.
devices.deviceApiUrl: Backend address the device will use
devices.deviceApiUrlHelp: For a phone on the school Wi-Fi use this PC's LAN address (e.g. http://192.168.1.20:8000), not localhost.
devices.qrHelp: Open the SchoolDimes POS app's setup screen and scan this code. It contains the backend address and the token.

merchants.title: Merchants
merchants.subtitle: Nearby shops approved to accept your students' cards. Approval is for your school only.
merchants.newHelp: The merchant is approved for your school straight away. Other schools approve it separately.
merchants.name: Name
merchants.approveHelp: Your students' cards will work at this merchant's devices from their next cache refresh. Parents can still block it per child.
merchants.suspendHelp: Your students' cards are removed from this merchant's devices at their next refresh; later sales are rejected. Past sales and the statement stay.
merchants.staffHint: To give merchant staff a login, create a merchant_staff account on the Staff accounts page.

products.title: Products
products.subtitle: What the canteen and merchants sell. Categories marked unhealthy feed the nutrition flag in Analytics.
products.name: Name
products.deleteCategoryHelp: Delete "{name}"? Prefer making it inactive if products or past sales use it.
products.deleteProductHelp: Delete "{name}"? Prefer making it inactive: past sales keep their line items either way.

policy.title: Policy & settings
policy.subtitle: School-wide spending rules and POS settings. Parents can tighten these per child but never loosen them.
policy.defaultsHelp: Applies to every student. Changes reach POS devices on their next cache refresh.
policy.posSettingsHelp: Per-school settings used by the offline POS devices.
policy.offlineHelp: How far below its cached balance a card may go across offline devices.
policy.pinLockHelp: Within 24 h; the card is frozen when reached.
policy.attendance_notify_guardians: Notify guardians on a student's first tap-in each day
policy.attendance_on_canteen_devices: Canteen tills may also record attendance taps
policy.overridesHelp: Set by parents (tighten only) or by you. Purple = set by a parent.
policy.removeHelp: {name} goes back to the school defaults, including any limits a parent set.

staff.title: Staff accounts
staff.subtitle: Logins for canteen staff, merchant staff, other school admins, and student-portal accounts.
staff.roleHelp_canteen_staff: Uses the POS app at the canteen. Can't sign in to this dashboard.
staff.roleHelp_merchant_staff: Linked to one approved merchant; sees that merchant's statement.
staff.roleHelp_school_admin: Full access to this school's dashboard.
staff.name: Full name
staff.passwordHelp: At least 8 characters. Share it privately.
staff.deactivateHelp: {email} can't sign in any more. Nothing they recorded is deleted.

fees.title: Fees
fees.subtitle: Uniform, trips, exam fees… Paid from a student's main wallet into the school's settlement wallet. Fees are exempt from snack spending caps.
fees.name: Name
fees.classesHelp: Leave empty for every class. Press Enter after each class (e.g. P4).
fees.payHelp: Debits the student's main wallet now and credits the school. Refused if the card is frozen or the balance is too low.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.subtitle: Card taps at the gate (or canteen, if enabled). Days are Africa/Kampala.
attendance.registerHelp: Present = at least one "in" tap that day. Offline readers' taps appear once they sync.

pooled.title: Pooled funds
pooled.subtitle: Class collections (trips, gifts…) with a transparent contribution log. Every total is computed from the fund's ledger.
pooled.ledgerNote: Raised, disbursed and held are summed from the fund wallet's ledger on every request.
pooled.closeHelp: No new contributions are accepted. Money already held stays in the fund until you disburse it.
pooled.disburseHelp: The fund holds {held}. Money moves out of the fund wallet at once; a mobile-money payout that fails is returned to the fund.
pooled.descriptionHelp: Required: what the money is for (shown in the transparent log).

disputes.title: Disputes
disputes.subtitle: Problems parents reported with a sale or fee. Refunds can never exceed what was actually charged.
disputes.startReviewHelp: Marks the dispute as under review; the parent is notified.
disputes.refundHelp: Credits {student}'s main wallet from the wallet that received the money. At most {max} can still be refunded. The parent is notified.
disputes.denyHelp: Closes the dispute with no money moving. The parent is notified with your notes.

p2pAlerts.title: P2P alerts
p2pAlerts.subtitle: Patterns in student-to-student transfers that may mean pressure or bullying. Alerts never block transfers; they're for a person to check.
p2pAlerts.rule_repeated_near_cap: Repeatedly sending close to the daily cap
p2pAlerts.reviewHelp: Record what you found (e.g. spoke to the class teacher).
p2pAlerts.historyHelp: Every transfer to or from this student.

privacy.title: Data requests
privacy.subtitle: Parents' requests to export, correct or delete personal data.
privacy.retention: Deletion redacts personal details (names, contact details, photos, ID numbers) and deactivates accounts. Financial records — the ledger, deposits, sales, fee payments and disputes — are kept, because they are the audit trail.
privacy.subject: About
privacy.handleHelp_export: The parent downloads their data in the app (My data). Mark completed once you've confirmed it.
privacy.handleHelp_correction: Make the correction on the student or account page first, then mark completed.
privacy.handleHelp_deletion: Completing a deletion is irreversible. A student with money in their wallets can't be redacted until it's withdrawn or spent.

tips.title: Financial tips
tips.subtitle: Short money tips shown to parents and students, one row per language.
tips.languageHelp: Write the tip in this language. A tip in each language is a separate entry.
tips.platformSubtitle: Tips shown at every school, one entry per language.

paymentIssues.title: Payment issues
paymentIssues.subtitle: Top-ups, gift vouchers and fund contributions that failed, expired or are still pending.
paymentIssues.depositsHelp: No money moved for failed or expired payments. A pending payment credits the wallet only when the aggregator confirms it.
paymentIssues.platformSubtitle: Webhooks we couldn't match to a payment, and failed payments across schools.
paymentIssues.markReviewedHelp: Record that someone has looked into this webhook (e.g. reconciled with the aggregator's dashboard). No money moves.

platform.schoolsHelp: Every school on SchoolDimes. Click a school to open its read-only support view.

onboard.title: Onboard a school
onboard.subtitle: Creates the school, its settings, spending policy, system wallets and first admin in one step.
onboard.name: School name
onboard.policyHelp: School defaults; the school admin can change them later and parents can tighten them per child.
onboard.adminHelp: This person signs in to the school dashboard and can add students, staff and devices.
onboard.adminPasswordHelp: At least 8 characters. Share it privately; they can be given a new one from Staff accounts.
onboard.reviewHelp: Create {name} with {email} as its first school admin?
onboard.doneHelp: {email} can now sign in at this dashboard, register devices, add students and issue cards.

referrals.title: Referrals
referrals.subtitle: Schools that referred other schools. Applying marks the reward as granted (billing is outside SchoolDimes).
referrals.applyHelp: Marks the referral applied and the reward for {school} as granted.

support.title: Support
support.subtitle: Read-only views of any school's students, cards, devices and transactions.
support.readOnly: Read-only. Any change you make for a school elsewhere is recorded in the audit log.
support.name: Name

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Privileged writes, including every cross-tenant change by platform staff.

portal.footer: {school} · Ask your parent or the school office if something looks wrong.

give.title: Send money to {name}
give.subtitle: Pocket money for {name} at {school}, via SchoolDimes. No account or app needed.
give.phoneOrEmail: A phone number or an email, so the family knows who sent it.
give.messagePlaceholder: Happy birthday! Buy yourself something nice.
give.payerPhoneHelp: Leave blank to use your phone above.
give.tooFast: Please check the details and press Continue again.
give.waiting: Waiting for the payment to be confirmed… you can keep this page open.
give.stillPending: Still waiting for confirmation. You can close this page: the money is only added when the payment provider confirms it.
give.thanks: The money has been added to {name}'s SchoolDimes wallet and the family has been told.
give.failed: The payment didn't go through ({reason}). No money was taken by SchoolDimes. You can try again.
give.invalid: The link may have expired or been switched off by the family. Ask them to send you a new one.
give.busy: Please wait a minute and reload the page.
give.privacy: SchoolDimes only shows the student's first name and school here. Balances and history stay private.
